newsitem.title: USA: Anheuser sells Budweiser in Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Anheuser sells Budweiser in Philippines.

text.p: Anheuser-Busch Cos said Monday its Budweiser beer is now sold in the Philippines through the company's local partner, Manila-based Asia Breweries Inc.
The local production is part of an agreement signed between Anheuser-Busch International and Asia Breweries earlier this year.
"As the fifth-largest beer market in Asia, the Philippines present enormous growth potential for Budweiser," said Steve Burrows, president and chief operating officer of Anheuser-Busch International.
Budweiser will compete in the premium segment of the Philippine beer market.
Anheuser-Busch holds a more than eight percent share of the world beer market and a leading 44.1 percent share of the U.S. beer market.
